item.title: ZeroDays Again
item.description:
I’ve seen people talking about ZeroDays again.

I genuinely don’t understand why people take those guys so seriously.

They’re skids.

That’s it.

I’ve watched people in that group spend hours talking themselves up over things that wouldn’t impress anyone who actually knew what they were doing. They seem to think using dramatic usernames and posting screenshots makes them some kind of elite group.

It doesn’t.

I normally wouldn’t bother mentioning them, but someone sent me a message asking if I was worried because apparently ZeroDays had been “looking into me”.

item.title: Summer Job
item.description:
I’ve been working a lot more recently, which is probably why I haven’t written anything for a while.

It’s not a particularly interesting job. Mostly the usual stuff, getting up too early, dealing with people who don’t know what they want, then coming home exhausted and pretending I’m going to do something productive.

I usually don’t.

The annoying thing is that I’ve actually got quite a lot of things I want to work on. I’ve got ideas for a few computer projects, a couple of games I’ve never finished and about ten films sitting on a list that I keep saying I’ll watch.

item.title: New Keyboard
item.description:
Finally replaced my keyboard today.

The old one was getting ridiculous. Half the keys needed to be hit twice and the space bar had developed this horrible squeak that made it sound like I was typing inside an old cupboard.

The new one is much quieter, which is nice because I tend to use my computer late at night.

Spent most of the afternoon setting everything up and moving things around on my desk. I also found a pile of receipts underneath my monitor that I have apparently been ignoring for several months.

item.title: The Guy Who Kept Arguing
item.description:
Some people genuinely don’t know when to stop talking.

I was in a group chat tonight and one guy kept arguing with everyone about absolutely everything. Nothing serious. Just one of those people who has to correct every sentence somebody writes.

Eventually he started having a go at me specifically.

I told him to leave it.

He didn’t.

Then he started with the usual stuff about how nobody could possibly know who he was because he didn’t use his real name.

item.title: Rainy Sunday
item.description:
It has rained pretty much all day.

I had planned to go out this morning but when I opened the curtains it looked like the entire street had been abandoned, so I went back to bed instead. Woke up again around eleven and spent another twenty minutes convincing myself that getting up was worth it.

Eventually I did.

Made some toast, cleaned the kitchen and then went into town to get a few things. I only needed shampoo and toothpaste but somehow came home with a new hoodie and a takeaway. This happens every time I go shopping.

item.title: Hello World
item.description:
Hello! Welcome to my blog.

I’ve been meaning to make one of these for ages but never really got around to it. Most of the stuff I do online ends up being random posts or messages that disappear after a few days, so I thought it would be nice to actually keep track of things somewhere.

I’ll probably write about whatever I’m doing, which could be anything from computers and random projects to films I’ve watched or places I’ve been.
